title.description: Event title, 1-200 characters, no line breaks

start.description: Start, RFC 3339 with offset (Z or +hh:mm) and zero seconds; from one day ago to one year ahead. For all_day: midnight in Asia/Seoul (T00:00:00+09:00)

end.description: Optional end, RFC 3339 with offset and zero seconds, after start. Default: start + 60 minutes (all day: next day 00:00 +09:00, exclusive)

notes.description: Optional notes, at most 500 characters, no line breaks

calendar_id.description: Optional calendar_id from calendar_list_events (default calendar when omitted)
